body.message:
As per your request, please find the 3-month rates for Urban Oasis.

September: AED 8,500
October: AED 10,000
November: AED 13,500

Please note that a refundable security deposit of AED 3,000 is required. The booking will be calculated on a monthly basis, with each month consisting of 30 nights.

If you would like to proceed with a 3-month booking, we would require the following payment in advance to secure and block the unit for you:

First month’s rent
AED 3,000 refundable security deposit
At least 50% of the final month’s rent

Once the required payment is completed, we can proceed with blocking the unit for the full 3-month period.

Thank you.
